simple.meaning: מוֹרָא (môwrâʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “fear ; by implication, a fearful thing or deed.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מוֹרָא (H4172) appears 12 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Genesis 9:2, with occurrences in Genesis, Deuteronomy, Psalms, Isaiah, Jeremiah, and 1 more.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מוֹרָא (H4172) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מוֹרָא (H4172) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מוֹרָא (môwrâʼ) / H4172 is traced through Genesis 9:2, Deuteronomy 4:34, Deuteronomy 11:25, Deuteronomy 26:8 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.short: fear ; by implication, a fearful thing or deed
definitions.usage: dread, (that ought to be) fear(-ed), terribleness, terror.

occurrences.englishText: The fear of you and the dread of you will be on every animal of the earth, and on every bird of the sky. Everything that moves along the ground, and all the fish of the sea, are delivered into your hand.

Or has God tried to go and take a nation for himself from among another nation, by trials, by signs, by wonders, by war, by a mighty hand, by an outstretched arm, and by great terrors, according to all that Yahweh your God did for you in Egypt before your eyes?
No man will be able to stand before you. Yahweh your God will lay the fear of you and the dread of you on all the land that you tread on, as he has spoken to you.
Yahweh brought us out of Egypt with a mighty hand, with an outstretched arm, with great terror, with signs, and with wonders;
and in all the mighty hand, and in all the awesome deeds, which Moses did in the sight of all Israel.
He will cut off the spirit of princes.
“Don’t say, ‘A conspiracy!’ concerning all about which this people say, ‘A conspiracy!’ neither fear their threats, nor be terrorized.
Yahweh of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
and brought your people Israel out of the land of Egypt with signs, with wonders, with a strong hand, with an outstretched arm, and with great terror;

“A son honors his father, and a servant his master. If I am a father, then where is my honor? And if I am a master, where is the respect due me? Says Yahweh of Armies to you, priests, who despise my name. You say, ‘How have we despised your name?’
“My covenant was with him of life and peace; and I gave them to him that he might be reverent toward me; and he was reverent toward me, and stood in awe of my name.
